name: Cherry KC 6000 Slim
notes: 65-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 0) of a real Cherry KC 6000 Slim, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://github.com/hrvach/deskhop/issues/236#issuecomment-3476100711. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
